method: Editorial review of actual standalone frames and recorded normal-input routes. No score is inferred from tests.

games.purpose: Third-person beacon, key and checkpoint adventure
games.notes: Replaced ribbon and primitive scenery with ranger, guardian, three beacon courts, connected stone causeway, woods, ruins and sanctuary. Fixed floor lips, authored long-level bounds, fall-to-checkpoint recovery and key-dependent win. Normal play lit all three beacons, collected Vale Key, won at 29.61 simulated seconds with 94 HP, and restarted.
games.remainingGaps: Compact sample depth; repeated arches and flat open expanses keep it below Featured. The 5–10 minute fantasy flagship ambition still needs richer pacing and bespoke art.

games.purpose: Relay objectives with first-person drone combat
games.notes: Built a readable panelled communications facility with original terminals, drones, weapon, warning accents and ambient/effect audio. Camera-aligned shooting, restore three relays, extraction and native Restart verified. Final normal win 34.57 sim/79 HP; actual wall collision retains invisible body and visible gun.
games.remainingGaps: Sparse industrial rooms and near-black surfaces limit visual depth. Drone combat and relay feedback are suitable for a focused sample.

games.purpose: Weapon switching, reload and compact arena combat
games.notes: Added deliberate cover lanes, original rifle/sidearm visuals, drone silhouettes, projectile/impact feedback and combat audio. Extraction now requires three defeats. Normal win 40.51 sim/60 HP, reload/switch, Pause, intentional loss and native Restarts verified.
games.remainingGaps: Arena remains small and visually repetitive. Finer recoil, animation, surface detail and encounter pacing would be needed for Featured.

games.purpose: Stealth perception, hearing and cover-based infiltration
games.notes: Retained intro camera, patrol/perception/hearing/Investigate and objective chain; authored machinery cover, readable Data Core, extraction lighting and alert/ambient sound. Crouched north-cover route, Data pickup, all three objectives and extraction won 30.72 sim with native Restart. A later screenshot route lost normally after lingering near guards, and also restarted.
games.remainingGaps: Facility is sparse and some surfaces remain dark. More explicit patrol feedback and varied cover encounters would improve the stealth experience.

games.purpose: Carry interactions and a multi-stage machinery puzzle
games.notes: Added generator machinery, cell, coolant consoles, pipes, route strips and ambient zones. Opened the formerly blocked coolant passage and fixed held-cell interaction priority; power plus both coolant switches control the exit. Full normal-input win recorded, with cell carried/consumed and gate/extraction progression. Latest framed replay won at 23.30 simulation seconds and native Restart passed.
games.remainingGaps: A coherent compact puzzle sample; broad bare surfaces, basic console feedback and limited puzzle complexity keep it below Featured.

games.purpose: Third-person equipment, state-machine guardian combat and a raised relic route
games.notes: Original ranger, stone guardians, rifle, ruins, woodland and authored audio replace engineering fixtures. Authored a flat terrain court so fixed-height guardians remain grounded; their timed touch damage uses real three-dimensional triggers and cannot hit through the raised ridge. The stone ramp now reaches the supported platform, the relic grants once and is destroyed, the objective HUD advances through weapon, guardian, relic and extraction, the gate opens after a kill, and the exit volume follows the low terrain edge. Normal keyboard-only route acquired the rifle, killed one guardian, climbed to the relic and won at 24.94 simulation seconds with 64 HP. Native Restart restored 100 HP, both guardians, no inventory and the first objective. Final extraction read 25.96 sim; zero browser errors and no visible helper objects. Final decorative relocation moves rocks and shrubs away from the platform and changes no gameplay properties.
games.remainingGaps: A compact sample rather than the a developed fantasy flagship. Sparse horizon, simple flat combat court, repeated kit pieces, modest lighting and close chase-camera framing remain below Featured. Detailed collision between enemies and polished ranged aiming are limited by the existing movement system. A no-defense loss on the final authored monitor is not yet independently recorded.

games.purpose: Terrain exploration, relic collection and a keyed shrine
games.notes: Added ranger, relic landmarks, trees/rocks/ruins/shrine, deliberate lighting, lava material and meaningful pickup/ending sound. Kept the three-relic/key/lever loop, grounded the player and moved health away from the objective. Normal route collectedthree relics and key, used lever, won at the shrine and restarted. One-shot pickup destruction prevents hidden relics from incrementing the counter again.
games.remainingGaps: Small collection loop with sparse terrain and repeated kit motifs; correctly scoped as a sample, not a flagship.

games.purpose: Woodland exploration and reusable vegetation
games.notes: Three species of original trees, shrubs and rocks replace the cube forest; amber waystones lead through three groves to a reachable lookout.
remainingGaps: Dense foliage still occludes some chase views; the compact woodland and simple light rig are below the Featured composition bar.

games.purpose: Skeletal combat animation and hitscan combat
games.notes: The dark skeletal test now has three readable armored sentries, a tiled forge court, cover and a clear kill objective. Final normal-input combat exposed and repaired two source-authoring gaps: sentries now deal supported contact damage, and the existing progress monitor ends the game at zero health. Fresh play verified three kills and Forge secured at 8.96 simulation seconds with 68 HP, then a separate no-defense loss at 10.73 seconds. Ordinary Restart clicks restored 100 HP and three live sentries after both endings; no browser errors.
remainingGaps: The open court needs a stronger focal structure and richer composition before Featured consideration; its reviewed visual and presentation scores remain 3/5.

games.purpose: Flags, switches and a gated objective
games.notes: Stone paving, seal beacons, chamber pillars and the east arch clarify the two-switch gate. A real keyboard route lights both seals and escapes.
remainingGaps: The topdown court is intentionally small and geometrically simple; the second legacy objective line remains redundant. Not a Featured environment.

games.purpose: Branching dialogue, inventory and level transitions
games.notes: A recognizable sailor, woodland doorway and inner shrine support the existing dialogue, key inventory and two-level sequence; conversation and gate authoring defects are repaired.
remainingGaps: Broad areas of flat green ground and a short dialogue keep this at Sample quality; no larger adventure or branching quest coverage is claimed.

games.purpose: Projectile weapons and bounded enemy spawning
games.notes: Guardians, relic projectiles, cover rocks and a gate replace the original enemy cubes and bare island. A flat tiled court and grounded spawner repair the floating-guardian presentation. Three bounded normal-input combat routes produced real projectile hits and losses. The strongest route reached three of eight kills by 9.51 simulation seconds and lost at 10.13 seconds; ordinary Restart reset health, kills and the spawner after every loss, with no browser errors. These attempts do not establish that the full objective is impossible, and no game state, damage values or success conditions were injected or weakened.
remainingGaps: A complete eight-kill normal-input victory remains unverified after three bounded routes; the best reached 3/8 kills. Review combat pacing, directional aiming feedback and survivability before public promotion.
Normal loss and ordinary Restart are verified. The open court remains a modest combat study rather than a Featured arena.

games.purpose: Inventory, dialogue and animated machinery
games.notes: Original turbine machinery, engineer, pipes and terminal make the fuel-cell puzzle legible. The floor intersection is repaired, and normal input collects three cells and restores power.
remainingGaps: The open facility perimeter and compact repeated panels are Sample scope; the opening camera could reveal more of the turbine and less of the floor.

games.purpose: Animated traversal, ramps and checkpoint recovery
games.notes: Painted terrain, ranger, ridge arch, vegetation and checkpoint beacon replace the old skeletal fixture; the intro now shows the ridge. The ramp was shortened to reach deck height before the player meets its vertical face, and a normal-input route now claims the relic in 8.18 simulation seconds.
remainingGaps: The camera transition and traversal feedback remain below Featured polish. The corrected ridge route is proven; checkpoint recovery and combat are not exhaustively tested.

games.purpose: Waypoint navigation around solid obstacles
games.notes: A guardian follows an authored waypoint route through a slate maze with amber waystones. Corrected the sealed starting passage, matched invisible waypoint heights to the grounded guardian and routed it through the open right corridor and lower passage. Existing health damage now ends the game at zero through a supported hidden graph monitor. A normal walking route won at 14.08 simulated seconds with 92 HP; zero jump inputs were required. After native Restart, the guardian traversed its route to the motionless player and produced a normal loss at 22.36 sim/0 HP. Native Restart after both endings restored 100 HP and the guardian. No runtime state was mutated for proof.
remainingGaps: Tall walls can obscure the chase view, and the green floor and repeated slate walls remain visually modest. The four-node authored route demonstrates bounded pathfinding; arbitrary dynamic obstacle navigation is outside this sample.

games.purpose: Menus, saving and a two-level sequence
games.notes: A cyan industrial route, consoles, cover and armored sentries give the outpost and deep relay clear identities. Normal input saves, transitions level and restores the final relay.
remainingGaps: Combat balance is not the demonstrated purpose of this short saving/sequence sample; the wide open facility and repeated bays do not reach Featured composition.

games.purpose: Timed wave sequencing and hovercraft survival
games.notes: Original drone hunters and tidal markers replace enemy cubes. Authored low-amplitude waves remove the default high-contrast foam bands while retaining animated water.
remainingGaps: The hovercraft body and seven parts are hard-coded cubeMesh geometry in spawnHovercraftController; authored visual assets are explicitly unsupported for this controller. A coherent vehicle model requires a shared controller/render extension. Timed victory is not proven.

games.purpose: Capped runtime spawning and timed survival
games.notes: Drone spawning, copper lighting, transmitter landmarks, a timer and subdued animated water distinguish this capped-spawner survival study.
remainingGaps: The hard-coded primitive hovercraft cannot be replaced through the current project schema; preserving vehicle physics requires a shared visual integration. The island remains sparse, and timed victory is not proven.

games.purpose: Textured objects, pickups and an objective gate
games.notes: Violet ruins, amber relics, a readable hazard and shrine now use original textures and meshes. Real movement collects all three relics and wins at the shrine.
remainingGaps: The compact mound and repeated columns are intentionally modest; a richer skyline and environment variety would be needed for Featured.

games.purpose: Terrain traversal, jumping and checkpoint recovery
games.notes: A proper guardian, checkpoint beacon, vegetation and distant ridge arch improve the original terrain traversal fixture while retaining its stepping stones. Added a hidden healthAtMost(0) → Lose graph and health-specific loss copy, so the existing ordinary guardian damage has a defined failure outcome. This authoring correction is not a claim of a completed traversal playthrough.
remainingGaps: The long route remains visually sparse, and the far goal is not visible from the opening frame. Jump/checkpoint/final-ridge completion remains unproven.

games.purpose: Terrain painting and blended ground materials
games.notes: Original moss, sand and stone materials preserve the terrain-paint study, with three survey beacons and a normal-input three-study win.
remainingGaps: This is a deliberately small terrain-material study with sparse props, not an adventure-sized environment; the camera can spend time on the outer trim.

games.purpose: Runtime prefab assemblies and reusable spawners
games.notes: Three drone fabrication bays, generators, panels and an inspection console replace floating prefab cubes. Recessed terrain fixes the hill protruding through the factory floor; real input inspects the console and wins.
remainingGaps: The factory is an open demonstration court with limited architectural enclosure. The console tests inspection completion, not an extended combat campaign.

games.purpose: Access gates, checkpoints and two-level facility play
games.notes: Metal panels, terminals, access card, drone bays and cover make the two-level facility readable. Normal input acquires the card, opens the route, crosses the checkpoint and reaches extraction.
remainingGaps: The corridor and panel vocabulary is deliberately compact and repeated; stronger environment storytelling and contrast would be needed for Featured.

games.purpose: Moving platforms, elevators and player carry
games.notes: Temple piers, textured slabs, a beacon lift switch and high shrine frame the original moving-platform and elevator systems. Slowing the existing lift clip from four to eight seconds prevents rider ejection at coarse timesteps; native input now boards, activates, rides and wins at the summit, then restarts.
remainingGaps: The route remains a compact movement study, with repeated masonry and occasional chase-camera edge views. Stronger route framing would be needed for Featured.

games.purpose: Hierarchy transforms and shaped collision
games.notes: Industrial machinery bays and a real swing-door animation replace the blank hierarchy fixture. Normal input passes the scanner, operates the door and reaches the final inspection console.
remainingGaps: The large floor and separated machines remain a technical inspection sample. It needs tighter architecture and visual density to qualify as Featured.

games.purpose: Platform jumps and a fall condition
games.notes: Stone platforms, inset panels, cyan lights, an animated ranger and summit gate preserve the floating-platform trial. Faster acceleration, a more forgiving jump and a fall volume covering all gaps repair the original tuning; a native C/W/Space precision route wins across all five platforms. Native loss and restart also pass.
remainingGaps: The route is intentionally linear and the platforms repeat. Careful steps use the existing C crouch control, now stated in help; a crouch-specific body animation and richer staging would improve presentation further.

games.purpose: Counter-driven pickups and contact hazards
games.notes: Drone hunters, amber orb models and small transmitter landmarks make the original counter/contact-hazard loop identifiable.
remainingGaps: The primitive vehicle is built directly by the hovercraft controller and ignores player visual assets. The four-orb normal-input win is not proven, and this island still needs a vehicle-focused composition pass.

games.purpose: Two-switch logic and a gated goal
games.notes: The legacy object-only project now has a ranger, title/controls/outcomes, two seal beacons, a colonnade and a shrine. Normal input activates both seals and passes the open gateway.
remainingGaps: Flat green ground and repeated pillars keep this compact logic demonstration at Sample quality; the redundant legacy objective line can be consolidated later.
